[[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[Scorpion (Dutch Player)|Scorpion]] wanted to join clan [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[Triple 7]], but because of his high ping, he was not allowed in. Reportedly, he then copied the [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[Triple 7]] clan website and put it online on a different server and added his name to the members list. Of course that lead to serious arguments, after which [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[Scorpion (Dutch Player)|Scorpion]] decided he could start his own clan. For unknown reasons he called it IT.

Members that joined where all from the same region: Aalten. The clan spawned some active players that where well known in the first years of the Dutch quake scene. 

== History ==
IT joined the first Quake LAN party in the Netherlands: Qday (100 participants). The players that went were: [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[Scorpion (Dutch Player)|Scorpion]], [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[Necrobic]], [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[KiF]], [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[Agony]]. They were amazed that everybody was playing with a mouse instead of keyboard only. The clan ended up in last place and after the most active players went to different clans, clan IT was disbanded. It briefly surfaced a few years later, but it was not a success.
